title_ar: طلب إستشفاء على نفقة وزارة الصحة
summary: Approval for the ministry to pay for an operation or hospital stay, for patients with no other health cover.
who_qualifies: Patients with no other health cover: not NSSF, the civil servants' cooperative, the army, internal security or an insurance company. Since 2 July 2026 the ministry pays 100% for uninsured Lebanese in public hospitals and some private ones, for all emergencies and a certain number of hospitalisation cases (not all).

documents.label_en: Detailed medical report: admission date, hospital stamp, doctor's stamp, signature and Order number, with the words "at the expense of the Ministry of Health"
documents.label_ar: تقرير طبي مفصل مع تاريخ الدخول وختم المستشفى وختم وتوقيع الطبيب ورقم انتسابه، مع عبارة "على نفقة وزارة الصحة"

documents.label_en: Individual civil registry extract (ikhraj qaid fardi), with the patient's photo if over 5
documents.label_ar: إخراج قيد فردي، وعليه صورة صاحب العلاقة إذا كان عمره أكثر من خمس سنوات

documents.label_en: NSSF statement that the patient is not covered by NSSF, no older than two months
documents.label_ar: إفادة من الضمان الاجتماعي بعدم استفادة المريض من التغطية الصحية، لا يتجاوز عمرها الشهرين

documents.label_en: Proof of kinship, if a relative applies for the patient
documents.label_ar: مستند يثبت صلة القرابة، إذا قدم الطلب أحد أفراد العائلة

fields.label_en: Who is applying (the patient, or a relative and how they are related)
fields.label_ar: مقدم الطلب (المريض أو قريبه وصلة القرابة)

fields.label_en: Patient confirms no other cover (the written pledge is signed at the desk)
fields.label_ar: يؤكد المريض عدم استفادته من أي جهة ضامنة أخرى (يوقع التعهد الخطي عند الاستلام)

desk: Card issuing centre, Hospitals Service, Directorate of Medical Care (مركز إعطاء البطاقات)
desk_contact: Bir Hassan, Jnah, near Ogero · hospitals@moph.gov.lb · 01-830300 ext. 510
after_approval: The approval is valid 15 days; the ministry's controller doctor at the hospital renews it.
how_it_works_today: The patient or a close relative brings the papers in person to the card centre in Bir Hassan, Monday to Saturday.

title_en: IVIG medicine (immune deficiency, ITP, Kawasaki, Guillain-Barré)
summary: Request for the ministry to provide IVIG for primary immune deficiency, ITP, Kawasaki disease or Guillain-Barré.
who_qualifies: Lebanese patients with no other payer, meeting the Drugs National Guidelines.

documents.label_en: ID card or civil registry extract
Detailed medical report from the doctor
Prescription with the exact dose and duration
documents.label_ar: الوصفة الطبية مع الجرعة والمدة بدقة

documents.label_en: Tests for the condition (ITP: CBC; Kawasaki: CBC, ESR; immune deficiency: CBC, platelets, smear, immunoglobulins)
Drugs Dispensing Center card, if the patient has one
documents.label_ar: بطاقة مركز توزيع الأدوية إذا وجدت

desk: Procurement and Supply Department, Diwan Service (دائرة التجهيز والتموين)
desk_contact: Bir Hassan, Jnah, near Ogero · drugs@moph.gov.lb · 01-830300 ext. 447
how_it_works_today: Fill form AK010IVIG-4 and hand it in with the documents at the ministry, or apply online with a site account.

summary: Medicine for haemophilia or thalassaemia, or anti-rejection medicine (Advagraf, Prograf) after an organ transplant.
who_qualifies: Haemophilia, thalassaemia and organ-transplant patients with a unified health number; Lebanese with no other payer.

documents.label_en: Detailed medical report naming the medicine, strength and daily dose
documents.label_ar: تقرير طبي مفصل مع ذكر الدواء والعيار والجرعة اليومية

documents.label_en: Unified prescription naming the medicine, strength and daily dose
documents.label_ar: وصفة طبية موحدة مع ذكر الدواء والعيار والجرعة اليومية

desk: Procurement and Supply Department, Diwan Service (دائرة التجهيز والتموين)
after_approval: The medicine is delivered to the chosen pharmacy in about 5 working days.
how_it_works_today: The documents are sent by WhatsApp to 81/348838, or the specialist files them on the AMAN platform.

title_en: Complaint about a hospital or health service
summary: A complaint to the ministry, for example a hospital asking for extra payment.
how_it_works_today: Call 1214, or use the ministry's app, website or email.
